Why It Matters

That ticket is more serious than you think

📈
Insurance Rates Spike

A single traffic conviction can raise your insurance premiums by hundreds of dollars per year — for years to come. Paying the fine is NOT the safe option.

🪪
License Suspension Risk

Too many points on your Missouri driving record triggers automatic suspension — affecting your job, your family, and your freedom to move.

⚠️
The Wrong Move Costs More

Paying a ticket is an admission of guilt. One bad decision today can follow your record for years. A $95 audit could save you thousands.
